name: gorm-health-migration
title: Health Repository 迁移到 GORM
description: 迁移 Health PostgreSQL Repository，保持 Scan/Schedule、SKIP LOCKED、Collection 与 River/Event 协作。
creator: lizhi
notes: Health GORM adapters and the scoped Collection verifier bridge are implemented. Local test/race/vet, Testcontainers compile, and real Testcontainers Scan/Schedule/Issue/River/Event/Affected-change/cancellation/trend gates pass through internal/platform/testdb. The remaining Collection integration pair is blocked before Health assertions because internal/graph/testfixture writes obsolete workspace status 'test' (SQLSTATE 23514). Fixed-statement tracer tests need a shared testdb tracer design outside this child; production composition, schema, and legacy deletion remain out of scope. Keep in_progress.
